content.title: Juno Upgrade (v23)
content.description:
# Juno Upgrade (v23)

 This upgrade includes: Minor verion bumps, Tokenfactory bugfix, Migration of Lobo, Jake and Dimi unvested funds to community pool. More details [here]](https://github.com/CosmosContracts/juno/releases/v23.0.0) .
## Voting Options
YES: Agree to proceed with the v23 network upgrade.
NO: Disagree with the v23 network upgrade.
